# Notes : GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD

## Answer
- Un routeur `rooms` existe deja, monte sur `/rooms` (app.ts:2, :9). Il expose GET `/`, GET `/:id`. Le sous-chemin `/:id/availability` n'existe pas.
- Une salle n'a pas d'horaires d'ouverture ni de granularite de creneau : rien dans src/ (Room, store.ts:1-6).
- Les reservations sont des bornes ISO 8601 avec `Z` en `string`, comparees par `Date.parse` (store.ts:13-14, overlap.ts:6-11).
- Aucun type `Result` dans le depot : le code existant leve `ValidationError` (validate.ts:4-6).
- Question ouverte : quel jour compte (UTC ou fuseau de Paris), et quelles heures d'ouverture.

## How it works
1. Demarrage : server.ts:5 appelle `createApp().listen(port)`, port 3000 par defaut (server.ts:3).
2. `createApp` (app.ts:5-11) : `express.json()`, `/health`, puis `app.use("/rooms", roomsRouter)` et `/bookings`. Aucun middleware d'erreur : une erreur non geree part sur le handler par defaut d'Express.
3. Routes existantes :
   - GET /health (app.ts:8)
   - GET /rooms (rooms.ts:6-8)
   - GET /rooms/:id, 404 `{error:"salle inconnue"}` (rooms.ts:10-16)
   - GET /bookings?roomId= (bookings.ts:9-16)
   - POST /bookings, 400 via ValidationError, 409 `{error, conflictsWith}` (bookings.ts:18-65)
   - DELETE /bookings/:id, 404 `{error:"reservation inconnue"}` (bookings.ts:67-75)
4. Modele (store.ts) : Room `{id,name,capacity,hourlyRate}` (:1-6), Booking `{id,roomId,who,people,startsAt,endsAt,price}` avec dates en string (:8-16). Quatre salles (:18-23), deux reservations seed (:25-44).
5. Acces lecture seule : `rooms`, `bookings`, `findRoom(id)` (:53-55), `bookingsForRoom(roomId)` (:57-59). Aucun filtre par date. `nextBookingId` (:46-51) est le seul effet de bord.
6. Les dates des reservations sont stockees telles que validees, sans normalisation (bookings.ts:52-53). Un decalage `+02:00` peut donc coexister avec `Z`. `Date.parse` les compare correctement.
7. Validation : `requireDate` (validate.ts:19-25) exige date+heure+fuseau. La regex `ISO_WITH_ZONE` (validate.ts:17) rejette donc `YYYY-MM-DD` seul. Il faudra un controle dedie pour le parametre `date`.
8. Date : seul helper, `isWeekend` via `getUTCDay` (price.ts:6-9), donc la convention du depot est UTC. `hoursBetween` (price.ts:11-13) renvoie des heures fractionnaires.
9. Chevauchement : demi-ouvert `[debut, fin[` (overlap.ts:4, :11). Deux creneaux bout a bout ne se chevauchent pas (test/overlap.spec.ts:27-36).

## Key files
src/app.ts:1-12 — montage des routeurs, /health, pas de middleware d'erreur
src/routes/rooms.ts:1-17 — routeur existant, cible naturelle de la nouvelle route (choix a faire)
src/routes/bookings.ts:18-65 — modele de validation + 400/409 ; `req.query` est type `string | ParsedQs` (typeof requis)
src/store.ts:1-59 — types et lecture seule ; ne pas modifier
src/lib/validate.ts:4-33 — ValidationError (status 400), requireString/requireDate/requirePositiveInt
src/lib/overlap.ts:1-12 — chevauchement demi-ouvert
src/lib/price.ts:6-13 — isWeekend (UTC), hoursBetween
test/rooms.spec.ts:4-14 — helper `call` : createApp + listen(0) + fetch + close
test/bookings.spec.ts:4-21 — helpers `call` et `post`, dates distinctes pour eviter les collisions (pas de reset du store)
vitest.config.ts:8-23 — garde-fou de nommage *.spec.ts, seuils de couverture
eslint.config.js:10-22 — eqeqeq, no-unused-vars (argsIgnorePattern ^_), no-explicit-any off dans test/

## Gotchas
- src/lib/AGENTS.md (verbatim) : « Un `export default` par module, qui expose la fonction principale. [...] le default est obligatoire » ; « Pas de JSDoc ici » ; « Les fonctions de ce dossier sont pures. Aucun acces reseau, aucun acces disque. ». Le code ne suit pas ces regles : aucun `export default` dans src/ (grep), et validate.ts:1-3 et overlap.ts:1-5 portent de la JSDoc.
- AGENTS.md (convention 1) exige la JSDoc sur toute fonction exportee, avec exception pour src/lib/. Les deux regles se contredisent pour src/lib.
- Les tests partagent le store d'un fichier : pas de reset, les tests POST changent de dates pour ne pas se gener (bookings.spec.ts:68-86, 113-122 depend du seed bk-1001).
- Ajouter une salle casse test/store.spec.ts:7 et rooms.spec.ts:27 (comptes et ids figes).
- ValidationError est la seule erreur attrapee (bookings.ts:59-63) ; les autres sont relancees, donc 500 par defaut.
- `rooms.ts` n'a pas de try/catch : un nouveau handler qui leve une ValidationError n'est pas converti en 400 sans l'ajouter.
- Seuils de couverture : lines/functions/statements 90, branches 85 (vitest.config.ts:23). Le script `coverage` les applique.
- Le hook post-ecriture (CLAUDE.md) relance typecheck, lint, tests, mais n'en bloque pas l'ecriture.

## Unknowns
- Jour : UTC ou fuseau local (Europe/Paris) ? Rien dans le depot ne le tranche. Il faut une decision produit.
- Horaires d'ouverture et granularite des creneaux : absents du code et des tests. Source a demander (ticket ou produit).
- Le fichier `.opencode/scratch/all-tests.config.ts` n'a pas ete lu (hors scope, n'entre pas dans vitest include).
- Git history et ticket INFRA-140 non consultes : Bash a ete refuse, donc pas de `git log`.
- Tests d'une route `/availability` : aucun n'existe ; le format de reponse est a definir.

# Add GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD returning the free slots of a room for one UTC day

## Goal
`GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=2031-03-04` answers 200 `{ roomId, date, slots: [{ start, end }] }`. `slots` are the gaps in the room's bookings inside the UTC day `[date T00:00:00Z, next day T00:00:00Z)`, as `toISOString()` strings (Z form), sorted. Bad input gives 400, an unknown room gives 404, both as `{ error }`. Unit and route tests exist, and `npm run check` and `npm run coverage` are green.

## Non-goals
- No opening hours, slot granularity or time zone parameter. No Europe/Paris day.
- No change to `src/store.ts`, `src/lib/validate.ts` or `src/app.ts`. No new dependency.
- No migration of existing code to `Result`. No fix of the `src/lib/AGENTS.md` contradiction.

## Assumptions and open questions
- BLOCKING: none. The points below were decided by the requester and can be overridden.
- assumption: the day is the UTC day (the repo already uses UTC, see `isWeekend` in `price.ts`). Without opening hours, free slots are the complement of the bookings in that window, so an empty room returns one slot covering the whole 24h.
- assumption: bookings crossing a day boundary are clipped to the window. Overlapping or adjacent bookings are merged (half-open `[start, end[`, consistent with `overlap.ts`). Zero-length gaps are omitted. Bookings may carry `+hh:mm` offsets, so compare with `Date.parse` and always output Z.
- assumption: `date` must match `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` and be a real calendar date (`2026-02-30` is rejected, and so are `2026-2-3`, `2026-03-04T00:00:00Z` and trailing characters). Check by round trip: `new Date(date + "T00:00:00Z").toISOString().slice(0, 10) === date`.
- assumption: order is 404 first, then 400. The room lookup is the existing pattern of `GET /rooms/:id`. Consequence: an unknown room with a bad date gives 404.
- assumption: `req.query.date` may be `string | ParsedQs | string[]`. Anything that is not a string counts as missing (400).
- assumption: new failing code returns a `Result` (AGENTS.md convention 2). The type goes in its own module `src/lib/result.ts`, types only. `validate.ts` stays as is.
- FLAGGED CONFLICT: root `AGENTS.md` convention 1 requires a JSDoc on every exported function, except in `src/lib/`. `src/lib/AGENTS.md` requires one `export default` per module and forbids JSDoc. Existing code follows neither: there is no `export default` anywhere in `src/`, and `validate.ts` and `overlap.ts` carry JSDoc. Decision: follow the existing modules. Use named exports only, with a one-line JSDoc on each exported function. Do not add `export default`. The human should confirm, or fix the rule file, since billing scripts supposedly load modules by their default export (not verified in this repo).
- assumption: purity (the one `src/lib/AGENTS.md` rule that is honoured) is kept. The lib function takes bookings as an argument and does not import `store.ts`.

## Files to touch
| File | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `src/lib/result.ts` | new, types `Result<T, E = string>` | minimal Result type, one responsibility |
| `src/lib/availability.ts` | new, `freeSlots` | pure slot computation and strict date check |
| `src/routes/rooms.ts` | add the `/:id/availability` handler | wiring, status codes |
| `test/availability.spec.ts` | new | unit tests of the computation |
| `test/rooms-availability.spec.ts` | new | route tests (kept apart so the frozen counts in `rooms.spec.ts` are untouched) |

## Steps
### 1. Pure computation, with its unit tests
- What: create `src/lib/result.ts` (`Result<T, E>` as `{ ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E }`). Create `src/lib/availability.ts` exporting `type Slot = { start: string; end: string }` and `freeSlots(date: string, bookings: ReadonlyArray<{ startsAt: string; endsAt: string }>): Result<Slot[], string>`. It returns `ok:false` with a French message for an invalid date. Otherwise it clips, sorts, merges and takes the gaps. Relative imports use `.js`.
- Where: `src/lib/result.ts`, `src/lib/availability.ts`, `test/availability.spec.ts`.
- Test cases to write (`test/availability.spec.ts`):
  1. no bookings: one slot `00:00Z` to next day `00:00Z`.
  2. one booking in the middle: two slots around it.
  3. booking starting at 00:00Z: no leading slot (zero-length omitted).
  4. booking ending at 24:00Z: no trailing slot.
  5. two adjacent bookings (end equals start): merged, one gap before and one after, none between.
  6. overlapping bookings: merged.
  7. unsorted input gives sorted output.
  8. booking starting the previous day and ending inside the day: clipped.
  9. booking starting inside the day and ending the next day: clipped.
  10. booking fully covering the day: `slots` is `[]`.
  11. bookings fully outside the day (before and after): ignored, whole day free.
  12. booking with a `+02:00` offset: converted correctly, output in Z.
  13. invalid dates each give `ok:false`: `""`, `"2026-02-30"`, `"2026-13-01"`, `"2026-3-4"`, `"2026-03-04T00:00:00Z"`, `"2026-03-04x"`, `"abc"`.
  14. leap day `2028-02-29` is accepted. `2027-02-29` is rejected.
  15. month and year rollover: `2026-12-31` ends at `2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`.
- Done when: `npx vitest run test/availability.spec.ts` passes, and `npm run check` exits 0.

### 2. Route wiring, with its route tests
- What: in `src/routes/rooms.ts`, add `roomsRouter.get("/:id/availability", ...)`. Order: `findRoom` (404 `{ error: "salle inconnue" }`), then read `req.query.date` (non-string is treated as missing), then call `freeSlots(date, bookingsForRoom(room.id))`. On `ok:false` answer 400 `{ error }`. On success answer 200 `{ roomId, date, slots }`. Do not throw. Add a one-line JSDoc only if a new exported function appears (none expected). Do not touch `store.ts`.
- Where: `src/routes/rooms.ts`, `test/rooms-availability.spec.ts`. Copy the local `call` helper (createApp, `listen(0)`, fetch, close) from `test/rooms.spec.ts`.
- Test cases to write:
  1. 200 for a room with no bookings on the queried day: `slots` is one full-day slot, `roomId` and `date` are echoed.
  2. 200 after a `POST /bookings` made in the test on a far-future date (distinct per test, since the store is never reset): two slots around it. Use dates that no seed booking uses.
  3. a seed booking (read the dates in `store.ts`): the day it falls on has that gap removed.
  4. 404 `{ error: "salle inconnue" }` for an unknown room with a valid date.
  5. 404 for an unknown room with a missing date (documents the 404-before-400 order).
  6. 400 for a missing `date`.
  7. 400 for `date=2026-02-30`, `date=2026-03-04T10:00:00Z`, `date=garbage`.
  8. 400 for a repeated parameter `?date=2026-03-04&date=2026-03-05`.
  9. `GET /rooms/:id` still returns 200 (no route shadowing).
- Done when: `npx vitest run test/rooms-availability.spec.ts` passes, and `npm run check` exits 0 (that includes the existing `rooms.spec.ts` and `store.spec.ts`, still unchanged and green).

### 3. Coverage gate
- What: run the coverage and add missing cases if `availability.ts` or the new handler is under the thresholds (lines, functions, statements 90, branches 85, from `vitest.config.ts`). Make no other change.
- Where: tests only, unless a real bug shows up.
- Done when: `npm run coverage` exits 0, and `npm run check` exits 0. Also confirm by hand that `src/store.ts` is unchanged (`git diff --stat -- src/store.ts` prints nothing).

## How this is verified
The test lists in steps 1 and 2 are the specification. They must be written first, before the implementation, and seen failing. Boundary cases covered: day edges (00:00Z and 24:00Z), clipping on both sides, adjacency, overlap, a full-day booking, offsets, an invalid calendar date, leap year, year rollover, a repeated query parameter, and 404 versus 400 order. Final gate: `npm run check` and `npm run coverage` both green.

## Risks and rollback
- A `/:id/availability` route does not collide with `/:id` in Express (a different segment count). Test 9 in step 2 guards this.
- Route tests that POST bookings change the shared store for that file only. Using distinct far-future dates avoids interference with `bookings.spec.ts` (separate test files get separate module instances in vitest, but verify).
- `Date.parse` accepts forms that `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` already rejects, so the regex must run first.

Bad input gives 400, an unknown room gives 404, both as `{ error }`. Unit and route tests exist, and `npm run check` and `npm run coverage` are green.
5	
6	## Non-goals
7	- No opening hours, slot granularity or time zone parameter. No Europe/Paris day.
8	- No change to `src/store.ts`, `src/lib/validate.ts` or `src/app.ts`. No new dependency.

10	
11	## Assumptions and open questions
12	- BLOCKING: none. The points below were decided by the requester and can be overridden.
13	- assumption: the day is the UTC day (the repo already uses UTC, see `isWeekend` in `price.ts`). Without opening hours, free slots are the complement of the bookings in that window, so an empty room returns one slot covering the whole 24h.
14	- assumption: bookings crossing a day boundary are clipped to the window. Overlapping or adjacent bookings are merged (half-open `[start, end[`, consistent with `overlap.ts`). Zero-length gaps are omitted. Bookings may carry `+hh:mm` offsets, so compare with `Date.parse` and always output Z.
15	- assumption: `date` must match `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` and be a real calendar date (`2026-02-30` is rejected, and so are `2026-2-3`, `2026-03-04T00:00:00Z` and trailing characters). Check by round trip: `new Date(date + "T00:00:00Z").toISOString().slice(0, 10) === date`.
16	- assumption: order is 404 first, then 400. The room lookup is the existing pattern of `GET /rooms/:id`. Consequence: an unknown room with a bad date gives 404.

1	# Add GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD returning the free slots of a room for one UTC day
2	
3	## Goal
4	`GET /rooms/:id/availability?date=2031-03-04` answers 200 `{ roomId, date, slots: [{ start, end }] }`. `slots` are the gaps in the room's bookings inside the UTC day `[date T00:00:00Z, next day T00:00:00Z)`, as `toISOString()` strings (Z form), sorted. Bad input gives 400, an unknown room gives 404, both as `{ error }`. Unit and route tests exist, and `npm run check` and `npm run coverage` are green.
5	
6	## Non-goals
7	- No opening hours, slot granularity or time zone parameter. No Europe/Paris day.
8	- No change to `src/store.ts`, `src/lib/validate.ts` or `src/app.ts`. No new dependency.
9	- No migration of existing code to `Result`. No fix of the `src/lib/AGENTS.md` contradiction.
10	
11	## Assumptions and open questions
12	- BLOCKING: none. The points below were decided by the requester and can be overridden.
13	- assumption: the day is the UTC day (the repo already uses UTC, see `isWeekend` in `price.ts`). Without opening hours, free slots are the complement of the bookings in that window, so an empty room returns one slot covering the whole 24h.
14	- assumption: bookings crossing a day boundary are clipped to the window. Overlapping or adjacent bookings are merged (half-open `[start, end[`, consistent with `overlap.ts`). Zero-length gaps are omitted. Bookings may carry `+hh:mm` offsets, so compare with `Date.parse` and always output Z.
15	- assumption: `date` must match `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` and be a real calendar date (`2026-02-30` is rejected, and so are `2026-2-3`, `2026-03-04T00:00:00Z` and trailing characters). Check by round trip: `new Date(date + "T00:00:00Z").toISOString().slice(0, 10) === date`.
16	- assumption: order is 404 first, then 400. The room lookup is the existing pattern of `GET /rooms/:id`. Consequence: an unknown room with a bad date gives 404.
17	- assumption: `req.query.date` may be `string | ParsedQs | string[]`. Anything that is not a string counts as missing (400).
18	- assumption: new failing code returns a `Result` (AGENTS.md convention 2). The type goes in its own module `src/lib/result.ts`, types only. `validate.ts` stays as is.
19	- FLAGGED CONFLICT: root `AGENTS.md` convention 1 requires a JSDoc on every exported function, except in `src/lib/`. `src/lib/AGENTS.md` requires one `export default` per module and forbids JSDoc. Existing code follows neither: there is no `export default` anywhere in `src/`, and `validate.ts` and `overlap.ts` carry JSDoc. Decision: follow the existing modules. Use named exports only, with a one-line JSDoc on each exported function. Do not add `export default`. The human should confirm, or fix the rule file, since billing scripts supposedly load modules by their default export (not verified in this repo).
20	- assumption: purity (the one `src/lib/AGENTS.md` rule that is honoured) is kept. The lib function takes bookings as an argument and does not import `store.ts`.
21	
22	## Files to touch
23	| File | Change | Why |
24	|---|---|---|
25	| `src/lib/result.ts` | new, types `Result<T, E = string>` | minimal Result type, one responsibility |
26	| `src/lib/availability.ts` | new, `freeSlots` | pure slot computation and strict date check |
27	| `src/routes/rooms.ts` | add the `/:id/availability` handler | wiring, status codes |
28	| `test/availability.spec.ts` | new | unit tests of the computation |
29	| `test/rooms-availability.spec.ts` | new | route tests (kept apart so the frozen counts in `rooms.spec.ts` are untouched) |
30	
31	## Steps
32	### 1. Pure computation, with its unit tests
33	- What: create `src/lib/result.ts` (`Result<T, E>` as `{ ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E }`). Create `src/lib/availability.ts` exporting `type Slot = { start: string; end: string }` and `freeSlots(date: string, bookings: ReadonlyArray<{ startsAt: string; endsAt: string }>): Result<Slot[], string>`. It returns `ok:false` with a French message for an invalid date. Otherwise it clips, sorts, merges and takes the gaps. Relative imports use `.js`.
34	- Where: `src/lib/result.ts`, `src/lib/availability.ts`, `test/availability.spec.ts`.
35	- Test cases to write (`test/availability.spec.ts`):
36	  1. no bookings: one slot `00:00Z` to next day `00:00Z`.
37	  2. one booking in the middle: two slots around it.
38	  3. booking starting at 00:00Z: no leading slot (zero-length omitted).
39	  4. booking ending at 24:00Z: no trailing slot.
40	  5. two adjacent bookings (end equals start): merged, one gap before and one after, none between.
41	  6. overlapping bookings: merged.
42	  7. unsorted input gives sorted output.
43	  8. booking starting the previous day and ending inside the day: clipped.
44	  9. booking starting inside the day and ending the next day: clipped.
45	  10. booking fully covering the day: `slots` is `[]`.
46	  11. bookings fully outside the day (before and after): ignored, whole day free.
47	  12. booking with a `+02:00` offset: converted correctly, output in Z.
48	  13. invalid dates each give `ok:false`: `""`, `"2026-02-30"`, `"2026-13-01"`, `"2026-3-4"`, `"2026-03-04T00:00:00Z"`, `"2026-03-04x"`, `"abc"`.
49	  14. leap day `2028-02-29` is accepted. `2027-02-29` is rejected.
50	  15. month and year rollover: `2026-12-31` ends at `2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`.
51	- Done when: `npx vitest run test/availability.spec.ts` passes, and `npm run check` exits 0.
52	
53	### 2. Route wiring, with its route tests
54	- What: in `src/routes/rooms.ts`, add `roomsRouter.get("/:id/availability", ...)`. Order: `findRoom` (404 `{ error: "salle inconnue" }`), then read `req.query.date` (non-string is treated as missing), then call `freeSlots(date, bookingsForRoom(room.id))`. On `ok:false` answer 400 `{ error }`. On success answer 200 `{ roomId, date, slots }`. Do not throw. Add a one-line JSDoc only if a new exported function appears (none expected). Do not touch `store.ts`.
55	- Where: `src/routes/rooms.ts`, `test/rooms-availability.spec.ts`. Copy the local `call` helper (createApp, `listen(0)`, fetch, close) from `test/rooms.spec.ts`.
56	- Test cases to write:
57	  1. 200 for a room with no bookings on the queried day: `slots` is one full-day slot, `roomId` and `date` are echoed.
58	  2. 200 after a `POST /bookings` made in the test on a far-future date (distinct per test, since the store is never reset): two slots around it. Use dates that no seed booking uses.
59	  3. a seed booking (read the dates in `store.ts`): the day it falls on has that gap removed.
60	  4. 404 `{ error: "salle inconnue" }` for an unknown room with a valid date.
61	  5. 404 for an unknown room with a missing date (documents the 404-before-400 order).
62	  6. 400 for a missing `date`.
63	  7. 400 for `date=2026-02-30`, `date=2026-03-04T10:00:00Z`, `date=garbage`.
64	  8. 400 for a repeated parameter `?date=2026-03-04&date=2026-03-05`.
65	  9. `GET /rooms/:id` still returns 200 (no route shadowing).
66	- Done when: `npx vitest run test/rooms-availability.spec.ts` passes, and `npm run check` exits 0 (that includes the existing `rooms.spec.ts` and `store.spec.ts`, still unchanged and green).
67	
68	### 3. Coverage gate
69	- What: run the coverage and add missing cases if `availability.ts` or the new handler is under the thresholds (lines, functions, statements 90, branches 85, from `vitest.config.ts`). Make no other change.
70	- Where: tests only, unless a real bug shows up.
71	- Done when: `npm run coverage` exits 0, and `npm run check` exits 0. Also confirm by hand that `src/store.ts` is unchanged (`git diff --stat -- src/store.ts` prints nothing).
72	
73	## How this is verified
74	The test lists in steps 1 and 2 are the specification. They must be written first, before the implementation, and seen failing. Boundary cases covered: day edges (00:00Z and 24:00Z), clipping on both sides, adjacency, overlap, a full-day booking, offsets, an invalid calendar date, leap year, year rollover, a repeated query parameter, and 404 versus 400 order. Final gate: `npm run check` and `npm run coverage` both green.
75	
76	## Risks and rollback
77	- A `/:id/availability` route does not collide with `/:id` in Express (a different segment count). Test 9 in step 2 guards this.
78	- Route tests that POST bookings change the shared store for that file only. Using distinct far-future dates avoids interference with `bookings.spec.ts` (separate test files get separate module instances in vitest, but verify).
79	- `Date.parse` accepts forms that `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` already rejects, so the regex must run first.
80	- The JSDoc / `export default` decision above may be overturned. The cost is adding a default export to `availability.ts`.
81	- Rollback: remove the five files and the added handler. No data or schema is affected.

**What I checked**

- **`npm run check`:** it is green. typecheck and lint are clean, and vitest reports 7 files passed and 66 tests passed with 1 skipped. That skip is in `overlap.spec.ts`, which this diff doesn't touch.
- **Clip, merge and gap logic** (`src/lib/availability.ts:23-42`):
  - **Contained bookings:** a booking inside an earlier merged interval cannot shrink the cursor, because `cursor = Math.max(cursor, b.end)`.
  - **Order and offsets:** the sort runs after clipping, so unsorted input is handled. `+hh:mm` offsets go through `Date.parse` and come out in Z.
  - **Bad store dates:** an unparseable booking date gives NaN. The `b.start < b.end` filter then drops it, so it cannot crash the endpoint or produce a bogus slot.
  - **Zero-length intervals:** a zero-length booking or gap is dropped.
- **Date validation:** the regex runs before `Date.parse`, as the plan's risks section requires.
  - **Rejected by the regex:** year 10000, negative years, `+002026-...`, and any date with trailing characters.
  - **Accepted:** `0000-01-01` passes the round trip.
  - **Calendar check:** `2026-02-30` fails the `toISOString().slice(0,10)` comparison.
- **Route** (`src/routes/rooms.ts:20-32`):
  - **Order:** the room lookup (404) comes before the date check (400).
  - **Query types:** an array or object `date` becomes `""`, which gives 400. That matches the "non-string counts as missing" assumption.
  - **Routing:** `/:id/availability` does not shadow `/:id`.
- **Test isolation:**
  - **Store sharing:** each spec file gets its own module instance in vitest, so the store does not leak between files.
  - **Data used:** the POST test uses `salle-b` on 2031-06-10, a date no seed booking uses. The seed-booking test asserts exact slots around `bk-1001`.
  - **Weakness check:** the assertions use `toEqual` on full slot arrays, so they would fail if the feature were removed.
- **AGENTS.md:**
  - **Imports and files:** relative imports use `.js`, there is no `utils.ts`, and test files are named `*.spec.ts`.
  - **JSDoc:** `freeSlots` has one.
  - **`Result`:** the type lives in its own types-only module.
